title: 航空材料
subtitle: Materials for Aircraft Structure
keywords: Steel materials 2.Non-ferrous metal materials 3.Fiber-reinforced composite materials 4.Materials evaluation test
educationalGoal: Aerospace vehicle are required to emphasize earth-friendly aspects and pursue high performance and high functioning at the same time. The various materials that compose aerospace vehicle have been steadily improving to satisfy these requirements. Students will learn the basic characteristic and applications of various materials such as aluminum, and fiber-reinforced composite materials for aerospace vehicle and other industrial products. Students will also use generative AI to explore the potential for entry into the local aerospace industry.
advice: The outline is as follows. 1. Overview of materials for machinery 1.1 Metallic materials, organic materials, inorganic materials, composite materials 1.2 Characteristics and evaluation tests of materials 1.3 Force and deformation, yield strength, tensile strength, Young’s modulus, Poisson’s ratio 2. Metallic materials 2.1 Crystal structure and dislocation 2.2 Deformation and fracture, elastic deformation and plastic deformation 2.3 Equilibrium diagram 2.4 Structure and heat treatment 2.5 Phase transformation and toughening of metal and steel 2.6 Aluminum, titanium 3. Composite materials 3.1 Fiber and resin 3.2 Molding methods and characteristics evaluation technology
books: Textbooks: Well-understood material science (in Japanese)){Morikita Publishing Co.Ltd.} Reference books: Unspecified Reserved books: Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: As a prerequisite, it is necessary to fully understand Strength of Materials. This is the first step to understanding the content of the course so the students can utilize reference book etc. on their own.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain practical materials such as steel materials, non-ferrous metal materials, and composites etc.
Be able to explain which materials are used in which areas of an aircraft.
Be able to explain basic evaluation test methods and features of metallic materials and composite materials.
Be able to explain how heat treatment affects properties of materials.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Explain more than five items of the main features and characteristic evaluations of metallic materials and composite materials. 2. Draw representative stress strain curve of metallic materials and unidirectional fiber-reinforced composite materials. Explain elastic modulus, yield stress, nonlinear behavior and permanent strain. 3. Understand and explain the phase diagram of steel. 4. Explain the differences in strength, rigidity and weight of steel, aluminum, titanium, and fiber-reinforced plastic composite materials. Explain the parts of the aircraft in which the materials are used and the reason.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Explain more than two items of the main features and characteristic evaluation technologies of metallic materials and composite materials. 2. Draw representative stress strain curve (compression/tension) of metallic materials and unidirectional fiber-reinforced composite materials. 3. Explain phase diagram of steel. 4. Explain the difference in strength, rigidity and weight of steel, aluminum, titanium, and fiber-reinforced plastic composite materials. Explain the parts (areas) of the aircraft in which the materials are used and the reason.
